// Reference translation of switch_vm `vm_fail` (corpus/src/switch_vm.c), written by hand and
// checked against the C source; program mode (the runtime shim `rt` is in scope).

/// Prints `vm error at pc=<pc>: <msg>` to stderr and exits with status 42.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn vm_fail(msg: *const u8, pc: u32) {
    unsafe {
        rt::eprintf(
            b"vm error at pc=%u: %s\n\0".as_ptr(),
            &[rt::Arg::UInt(u64::from(pc)), rt::Arg::Ptr(msg)],
        );
    }
    rt::exit(42)
}
</kraken-rust>

// Reference translation of switch_vm `op_name`: the mnemonic of an opcode, as a pointer to a
// NUL-terminated static string (so the function-level test only compiles it: pointers are not
// comparable between the original and the Rust build).

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn op_name(op: u32) -> *const u8 {
    let name: &'static [u8] = match op {
        0 => b"halt\0",
        1 => b"push\0",
        2 => b"add\0",
        3 => b"sub\0",
        4 => b"mul\0",
        5 => b"dup\0",
        6 => b"swap\0",
        7 => b"drop\0",
        8 => b"neg\0",
        9 => b"jnz\0",
        10 => b"dec\0",
        11 => b"print\0",
        12 => b"and\0",
        13 => b"or\0",
        14 => b"xor\0",
        _ => b"?\0",
    };
    name.as_ptr()
}
</kraken-rust>

// Reference translation of switch_vm `push`; calls the translated `vm_fail`.

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Vm {
    pub stack: [i32; 32],
    pub sp: i32,
    pub pc: u32,
    pub steps: u64,
}

/// Pushes `v`; a full stack ends the program through `vm_fail`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn push(vm: *mut Vm, v: i32) {
    unsafe {
        if (*vm).sp >= 32 {
            vm_fail(b"stack overflow\0".as_ptr() as _, (*vm).pc);
        }
        let sp = (*vm).sp;
        (*vm).stack[sp as usize] = v;
        (*vm).sp = sp.wrapping_add(1);
    }
}
</kraken-rust>

// Reference translation of switch_vm `pop`; calls the translated `vm_fail`.

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Vm {
    pub stack: [i32; 32],
    pub sp: i32,
    pub pc: u32,
    pub steps: u64,
}

/// Pops the top of the stack; an empty stack ends the program through `vm_fail`.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn pop(vm: *mut Vm) -> i32 {
    unsafe {
        if (*vm).sp <= 0 {
            vm_fail(b"stack underflow\0".as_ptr() as _, (*vm).pc);
        }
        (*vm).sp = (*vm).sp.wrapping_sub(1);
        (*vm).stack[(*vm).sp as usize]
    }
}
</kraken-rust>
<kraken-result>{"assumptions": [], "unsupported": []}</kraken-result>

// Reference translation of switch_vm `vm_run`; calls the translated `push`, `pop` and `vm_fail`.

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Vm {
    pub stack: [i32; 32],
    pub sp: i32,
    pub pc: u32,
    pub steps: u64,
}

/// Runs bytecode `code[..len]` on `vm`; returns the top of the stack at HALT (0 when empty).
/// An operand or a jump target is fetched without a bounds check, as in the original.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn vm_run(vm: *mut Vm, code: *const u8, len: u32) -> i32 {
    unsafe {
        loop {
            if (*vm).pc >= len {
                vm_fail(b"pc out of range\0".as_ptr() as _, (*vm).pc);
            }
            let op = *code.add((*vm).pc as usize);
            (*vm).pc = (*vm).pc.wrapping_add(1);
            (*vm).steps = (*vm).steps.wrapping_add(1);
            match op {
                0 => {
                    return if (*vm).sp != 0 {
                        (*vm).stack[((*vm).sp - 1) as usize]
                    } else {
                        0
                    };
                }
                1 => {
                    let imm = *code.add((*vm).pc as usize) as i8 as i32;
                    (*vm).pc = (*vm).pc.wrapping_add(1);
                    push(vm as _, imm);
                }
                2 => {
                    let b = pop(vm as _);
                    let a = pop(vm as _);
                    push(vm as _, a.wrapping_add(b));
                }
                3 => {
                    let b = pop(vm as _);
                    let a = pop(vm as _);
                    push(vm as _, a.wrapping_sub(b));
                }
                4 => {
                    let b = pop(vm as _);
                    let a = pop(vm as _);
                    push(vm as _, a.wrapping_mul(b));
                }
                5 => {
                    let a = pop(vm as _);
                    push(vm as _, a);
                    push(vm as _, a);
                }
                6 => {
                    let b = pop(vm as _);
                    let a = pop(vm as _);
                    push(vm as _, b);
                    push(vm as _, a);
                }
                7 => {
                    pop(vm as _);
                }
                8 => {
                    let a = pop(vm as _);
                    push(vm as _, a.wrapping_neg());
                }
                9 => {
                    let a = pop(vm as _);
                    if a != 0 {
                        (*vm).pc = u32::from(*code.add((*vm).pc as usize));
                    } else {
                        (*vm).pc = (*vm).pc.wrapping_add(1);
                    }
                }
                10 => {
                    let a = pop(vm as _);
                    push(vm as _, a.wrapping_sub(1));
                }
                11 => {
                    // The original reads stack[sp - 1] without checking sp; so does this.
                    let top = *(*vm).stack.as_ptr().offset((*vm).sp as isize - 1);
                    rt::printf(b"out: %d\n\0".as_ptr(), &[rt::Arg::Int(i64::from(top))]);
                }
                12 => {
                    let b = pop(vm as _);
                    let a = pop(vm as _);
                    push(vm as _, a & b);
                }
                13 => {
                    let b = pop(vm as _);
                    let a = pop(vm as _);
                    push(vm as _, a | b);
                }
                14 => {
                    let b = pop(vm as _);
                    let a = pop(vm as _);
                    push(vm as _, a ^ b);
                }
                _ => vm_fail(b"bad opcode\0".as_ptr() as _, (*vm).pc.wrapping_sub(1)),
            }
        }
    }
}

// Reference translation of switch_vm `main`; the entry point of the program. Calls the
// translated `vm_run` and `op_name` and prints through the runtime shim.

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Vm {
    pub stack: [i32; 32],
    pub sp: i32,
    pub pc: u32,
    pub steps: u64,
}

/// Runs a fixed bytecode program (an arithmetic prelude, then a countdown from 5 that prints
/// each value) and prints the result, the step count and the name of the first opcode.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn fn_101707() -> i32 {
    const PROG: [u8; 17] = [1, 6, 1, 7, 4, 1, 3, 14, 7, 1, 5, 11, 10, 5, 9, 11, 0];
    let mut vm = Vm {
        stack: [0; 32],
        sp: 0,
        pc: 0,
        steps: 0,
    };
    unsafe {
        let r = vm_run(&mut vm as *mut Vm as _, PROG.as_ptr() as _, PROG.len() as u32);
        let first = op_name(u32::from(PROG[0]));
        rt::printf(
            b"result=%d steps=%lu first=%s\n\0".as_ptr(),
            &[
                rt::Arg::Int(i64::from(r)),
                rt::Arg::UInt(vm.steps),
                rt::Arg::Ptr(first),
            ],
        );
    }
    0
}
